_comment: apps/web. This is the rule that makes client-error-monitor.yml retirable:
the same errors, grouped and symbolicated, minutes after they happen
rather than on an hourly cron that reads over a million log rows.
Do not retire that workflow on the strength of this file existing. The
workflow is fed by a second, vendor-less path (apps/web's fanout to
/api/client-errors) that keeps working when the provider chunk fails to
load at all - which is exactly the stale-tab-after-deploy case. Retire it
once this rule has been seen to fire, on purpose, per onlooker-k34.
